policy.cadence: The original USD/TWD >33 halving of VOO/009826 monthly baseline and cap remains an upper limit; a preference to wait can reduce buying, never increase those limits. Existing scheduled DCA instructions are not automatically canceled or changed.
policy.cheap_exception: Only source-verified instrument classification and own same-session price versus complete 52-week price high can support an exception review: individual STOCK drawdown >= 30%; ETF drawdown strictly > 10%. Exact 10% ETF drawdown is insufficient. Unknown classification gets no exception; never infer ETF status from ticker text. This releases only the FX preference, never universe, stabilization, strategic price, funding, target/group/total-cap or execution rules.
policy.d130_precedence: D-215 explicitly supersedes the older D-130 restriction against other conditions reducing a price-suitable one-lot recommendation only for this accepted FX preference: an eligible strategic or emergency TWD bond-ETF buy may WAIT_PREFERRED when FX is high without its own verified >10% ETF drawdown exception. Preserve quota, target, funding, source and all other original constraints.
policy.formula: High FX cost when qualified live USD/TWD > 32.8 OR (live USD/TWD - lowest rate in exact last two calendar years) / (highest - lowest) >= 0.90. This is range position, not an empirical percentile. Test exact boundaries by Decimal cross multiplication; a zero range is UNKNOWN. Use coherent BANK_SPOT_SELLING USD sell rates, not MID/buy/sell mixing. Historical canonical rows do not record provider; disclose this uncertainty and do not claim same-provider proof.
policy.historical_basis_readiness: Legacy canonical rows with mixed cash/spot sell-rate origins cannot prove this range. Use only the actually completed, provenance-verified two-year BANK_SPOT_SELLING source from the separately authorized data repair; unknown/mixed rows remain excluded and source gaps remain UNKNOWN until verified readback, never relabeled by declaration.
policy.historical_provider_status: Preserve actual recorded source/provider provenance; explicit unknown on old rows is disclosure, not proof of coherent spot basis.
policy.missing_evidence: Missing current rate means UNKNOWN. When current rate <=32.8 but complete two-calendar-year range is unavailable, retain UNKNOWN and disclose it; never substitute one-year history, a five-year percentile or zero range. A verified current rate >32.8 independently establishes HIGH even when range is unknown; a separately verified cheap-asset exception may then be reviewed, not inferred from missing data. With a qualified current live bank spot selling rate and verified own-asset cheap exception, the FX preference can be waived even if the two-year range remains UNKNOWN: the verified exception covers either possible FX state. Retain UNKNOWN risk/range, never invent HIGH or NORMAL. Missing current cost/source cannot be waived.
policy.native_history_coverage: Retain all legacy UNKNOWN canonical rows. Exclude their prices/count them only when immutable trusted FinMind NATIVE_QUERY URL intervals for TaiwanExchangeRate/USD continuously cover the exact window through independent completed D, with qualified source-member-bound prices, boundary and latest D. Bank OBSERVATION captures may supply verified SPOT prices but never query coverage. Do not require all canonical dates to be native bank days or relabel legacy as verified.
policy.preference: Prefer waiting when FX is HIGH; not a report-wide financial halt. Respect existing scoped verified BLOCKED and all non-FX gates. This preference cannot cancel or alter actual broker scheduled DCA orders.
policy.purchase_scope: All proposed new USD-denominated asset BUY/ADD, including VOO/VT/SGOV, whether funded by existing USD or TWD sub-brokerage; also all source-verified BOND_ETF purchases traded in TWD, including strategic D-130 and emergency 00865B sleeves, as Steven explicitly specified. Do not infer bond ETF classification from ticker names. TWD-traded stock ETFs such as 0050/00881 do not enter the FX scope solely through USD underlying exposure. Do not execute conversion, transfer or order actions.
